headline: Tidal RUSH rain waits one more night at the gate
lede: The squall-that-pushes build (#3191/PR #3194) is proven and merge-ready, but main went red again tonight: the nightly-refresh run cleared the original four failures and then tripped on the watch/autopilot pixel-sense family.

notes.text: Slot b resumed #3191 and re-validated the hold: PR #3194 clean vs post-fix main, and a local build confirms the production chunk carries the rain signatures (rain:, frontW, 0.72, 1.55) — one green nightly from shipping.

Fix #3193 landed 20:35Z and the refresh nightly cleared every family it targeted (roster soak, GrindCity dvh, mergecheck, panes) before failing on new terrain: watchcheck's FLOORBOSS pin (#3027) and zeldaplay reading 0 face px — senses blind, not Link misplaced (#3205 filed).
Release arithmetic: the full nightly runs ~2h36m, so freeing the freeze is a ~3-hour pipeline (fix + dispatch + run). Rule-5a quarantine naming #3027/#3205 is the fast lane if fixes aren't quick.
